mods.name: Blood Magic
mods.description: Sacrifice hearts for powerful temporary buffs. Server-side only: vanilla clients need no mod to play.

releases.notes:
Blood Magic now runs **entirely on the server**. Players join with an unmodified vanilla client and install nothing — no mod, no Fabric, no resource pack.

Drop `bloodmagic-0.3.0.jar` into your server's `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API and restart.

Requires Minecraft **26.2**, Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**, Fabric API **0.152.2+26.2**.

## What changed

The ten buffs used to be custom `MobEffect` registry entries, which made registry sync reject any vanilla client outright. Those are gone, along with the entire client source set (custom `Screen`, custom `HudElement`, B-key polling) and both custom packets. Everything a player sees is now built from vanilla parts:

| Was | Is now |
|---|---|
| Custom `Screen` on the B key | `minecraft:generic_9x2` chest menu via `/blood` |
| Custom HUD cooldown bars | Vanilla boss bars |
| Custom effect icons | Vanilla item icons with tooltips |
| Custom serverbound packet | `/blood use <buff>` and menu clicks |

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Action |
|---|:---:|---|
| `/blood` | everyone | Open the sacrifice menu |
| `/blood status` | everyone | List active buffs and cooldowns |
| `/blood use <buff>` | everyone | Activate a buff directly |
| `/blood clear [player]` | level 2 | Drop all buffs, debts and cooldowns |

Rooted at `/blood` rather than `/bloodmagic` to avoid colliding with the item-import mod.

## Bug fixes

- **Timers no longer break on restart.** Expiry was recorded with `MinecraftServer#getTickCount`, which restarts at zero every boot, while the HUD read `Level#getGameTime`. Persisted buffs looked far in the future after a restart and never expired. Everything uses world game time now.
- **Buffs cost half what they used to.** Activation subtracted the cost from `MAX_HEALTH` — which clamps current health down — and *then* dealt the same amount again as magic damage, charging twice.
- **Buffs no longer run during their cooldown.** Hemorrhage, Life Drain and Blood Ward kept firing for the full ten-minute regen window.
- **Blood Ward** no longer absorbs the activation cost of the next buff you buy, and no longer strands its heart debt permanently when it triggers.
- **Night Vision from other sources** is no longer stripped during a Crimson Sight cooldown.
- **Relogging** keeps your buffs. Modifiers are transient but the buff list persists, so a relog used to leave you holding the cooldown with none of the buff. They are rebuilt on join, respawn, End return and dimension change.
- Malformed saved buff data no longer throws.

## Upgrading

Buff entries saved by 0.1.x use the old restart-unstable clock. They read as expired and are discarded the first time each player logs in after the update — players get their hearts back and start clean.

> Note: this is a different design from `v0.2.0-altar`, which delivers buffs through a placeable Blood Altar block with percentage-based costs. This release continues the `main` line.

releases.notes:
Fixes a server startup crash (`NullPointerException: Block id not set`) present in the previous **v0.2.0-altar** release, which shipped with an unfinished/broken Blood Altar block registration.

That in-progress altar feature has been removed. This release is functionally equivalent to v0.1.0 (potion-effect buffs via commands/triggers) and is confirmed to start cleanly.

**If you installed `bloodmagic-0.2.0.jar`, remove it and replace it with `bloodmagic-0.1.1.jar`.**

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API 0.158.0+26.2.

releases.notes:
Server-side-only redesign: buffs now come from a placeable **Blood Altar** you right-click to open, with costs scaled as a percentage of your current max health rather than flat hearts. No client mod needed — vanilla clients join fine.

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API 0.158.0+26.2.

Drop `bloodmagic-0.2.0.jar` into your server's `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API and restart. See the README on the `altar-port` branch for the full buff list and crafting recipe.
